name: openobserve
description: Use OpenObserve directly in Claude Code through a preconfigured OpenObserve MCP server. Query logs, metrics and traces with SQL and PromQL, and work with streams, dashboards and alerts through natural conversation.

base_url.title: OpenObserve URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your OpenObserve instance, without a trailing slash. Cloud regions: https://cloud.openobserve.ai (US), https://eu1.openobserve.ai, https://ap1.openobserve.ai. Self-hosted: your own host, e.g. https://o2.example.com.

org_id.title: Organization ID
org_id.description: The organization identifier shown in the OpenObserve UI (the org_identifier in the URL). Self-hosted single-org installs usually use 'default'.
